quranTranslation.text: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: Allah je doista čuo riječ žene koja se prepirala s tobom oko svoga muža – sluh kojem ništa ne izmiče.
explanation.en: Allah has heard the words of her who disputed with you about her husband — a hearing nothing escapes.

quranTranslation.text: Be not as those who say, we hear, and they hear not.

explanation.bs: Oni „koji govore: Čuli smo, a oni ne čuju“ – čuti bez razumijevanja i pokornosti.
explanation.en: Those “who say, we hear, and they hear not” — hearing without understanding and obedience.

quranTranslation.text: The messenger believeth in that which hath been revealed unto him from his Lord and (so do) believers. Each one believeth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers - We make no distinction between any of His messengers - and they say: We hear, and we obey. (Grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord. Unto Thee is the journeying.

explanation.bs: „Čuli smo i pokorili smo se“ – sluh kao prihvatanje.
explanation.en: “We hear, and we obey” — hearing as acceptance.

quranTranslation.text: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,

explanation.bs: Skupina džina slušala je Kur'an – namjerno slušanje koje vodi vjerovanju.
explanation.en: A company of jinn listened to the Quran — deliberate listening that led to belief.

quranTranslation.text: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.

explanation.bs: „Zato slušaj ono što se objavljuje“ – Musau se naređuje pažljivo slušanje.
explanation.en: “So hearken unto that which is inspired” — Moses is told to listen with full attention.

quranTranslation.text: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.

explanation.bs: Džini prisutni pri učenju Kur'ana rekoše: „Šutite!“
explanation.en: The jinn present at the recitation told one another to fall silent (أَنْصِتُوا).

quranTranslation.text: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Uputa bogobojaznima“ – Knjiga kao uputa.
explanation.en: “A guidance unto those who ward off (evil)” — the Book as guidance.

quranTranslation.text: While as for those who walk aright, He addeth to their guidance, and giveth them their protection (against evil).

explanation.bs: Onima koji su na pravom putu On uputu povećava – uputa kao pomoć upućenima.
explanation.en: Those who are guided — He increases them in guidance: guidance as help to the guided.

quranTranslation.text: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

explanation.bs: Ko bude slijedio Moju uputu, ni straha ni tuge za njih – uputa poslana ljudima.
explanation.en: Whoever follows My guidance — no fear for them, nor will they grieve: guidance sent to people.

quranTranslation.text: There is no compulsion in religion. The right direction is henceforth distinct from error. And he who rejecteth false deities and believeth in Allah hath grasped a firm handhold which will never break. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Pravi put se jasno razlučio od stranputice“ – رُشْد nasuprot غَيّ.
explanation.en: “The right direction is henceforth distinct from error” — رُشْد against غَيّ.

quranTranslation.text: Prove orphans till they reach the marriageable age; then, if ye find them of sound judgment, deliver over unto them their fortune; and devour it not by squandering and in haste lest they should grow up Whoso (of the guardians) is rich, let him abstain generously (from taking of the property of orphans); and whoso is poor let him take thereof in reason (for his guardianship). And when ye deliver up their fortune unto orphans, have (the transaction) witnessed in their presence. Allah sufficeth as a Reckoner.

explanation.bs: Kad kod siročadi primijetite zrelost (رُشْد), predajte im imetak – dunjalučka razboritost.
explanation.en: When you perceive in the orphans sound judgement (رُشْد), release their property to them — worldly good sense.

quranTranslation.text: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.

explanation.bs: Oni koji su primili islam, pravi put (رَشَد) su izabrali – ispravnost u vjeri, koju mišljenje što ga ar-Rāġib prenosi veže za ahiret.
explanation.en: Whoever has accepted Islam — those have sought out the right course (رَشَد) — rightness in religion, which the view ar-Rāġib reports ties to the hereafter.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah pardoneth not that partners should be ascribed unto Him. He pardoneth all save that to whom He will. Whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah hath wandered far astray.

explanation.bs: Ko Allahu pripisuje druga, daleko je zalutao – ضَلَال بَعِيد, najveća zabluda.
explanation.en: Whoever associates others with Allah has gone far astray — ضَلَال بَعِيد, the greatest error.

quranTranslation.text: When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be. Lo! our father is in plain aberration.

explanation.bs: Braća kažu da je njihov otac „u očitoj zabludi“ – za njih je pogriješio u ljubavi prema Jusufu, ne u vjeri.
explanation.en: The brothers say their father is “in plain aberration” — to them he erred in his love for Joseph, not in faith.

quranTranslation.text: Such then is Allah, your rightful Lord. After the Truth what is there saving error? How then are ye turned away!

explanation.bs: „Pa šta ima nakon istine osim zablude?“ – ضَلَال kao sve što nije istina.
explanation.en: “After the Truth what is there saving error?” — ضَلَال as all that is not the truth.

quranTranslation.text: There is no compulsion in religion. The right direction is henceforth distinct from error. And he who rejecteth false deities and believeth in Allah hath grasped a firm handhold which will never break. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: Pravi put se jasno razlikuje od zablude (غَيّ) – zato nema prisile u vjeri.
explanation.en: The right course is distinct from the wrong (غَيّ) — so there is no compulsion in religion.

quranTranslation.text: I shall turn away from My revelations those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth, and if they see each token believe it not, and if they see the way of righteousness choose it nor for (their) way, and if they see the way of error choose if for (their) way. That is because they deny Our revelations and are used to disregard them.

explanation.bs: Ako vide put zablude, uzimaju ga za put – svjesno biranje krivog puta.
explanation.en: If they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way — knowingly choosing the wrong road.

quranTranslation.text: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.

explanation.bs: Pokoljenja koja su zapustila namaz i povela se za strastima – susrest će غَيّ (tefsir ga tumači kao propast ili kao dolinu u Džehennemu).
explanation.en: Generations that neglected prayer and followed desires will meet غَيّ (tafsir explains it as ruin, or as a valley in Hell).

quranTranslation.text: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,

explanation.bs: „I tražite pomoć strpljenjem i namazom.“
explanation.en: “Seek help in patience and prayer.”

quranTranslation.text: And when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts they said: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: Talutovi vojnici pred Džalutom: „Gospodaru naš, prelij nas strpljenjem i učini čvrstim korake naše“ – strpljenje u borbi, koje ar-Rāġib naziva i hrabrošću.
explanation.en: Saul's soldiers facing Goliath: “Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance (صَبْرًا), make our foothold sure” — patience in battle, which ar-Rāġib also calls courage.

quranTranslation.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

explanation.bs: Jakub, kad su mu donijeli košulju s lažnom krvlju: „Lijepo strpljenje!“
explanation.en: Jacob, when the shirt with false blood was brought to him: “(My course is) comely patience.”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.

explanation.bs: „Ibrahim je zaista bio blag, skrušen i pokajan“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! Abraham was mild (لَحَلِيمٌ), imploring, penitent” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

explanation.bs: „Pa smo ga obradovali blagim dječakom“ – ar-Rāġib: dječak u kome je bila snaga blagosti.
explanation.en: “So We gave him tidings of a gentle son (حَلِيمٍ)” — ar-Rāġib: one in whom the strength of forbearance was found.

quranTranslation.text: A kind word with forgiveness is better than almsgiving followed by injury. Allah is Absolute, Clement.

explanation.bs: „Lijepa riječ i opraštanje bolji su nego sadaka za kojom slijedi uznemiravanje; a Allah je Neovisan i Blag“ – blagost kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “A kind word with forgiveness is better than almsgiving followed by injury. Allah is Absolute, Clement (حَلِيمٌ)” — forbearance as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;

explanation.bs: „I koji suzdržavaju srdžbu i opraštaju ljudima – a Allah voli one koji čine dobro“ (Njegova ljubav kako Njemu priliči) – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good” (His love as befits Him) — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard.

explanation.bs: Na Dan koji se približava, „kad srca budu kod grla, a oni se jedva suzdržavaju“ – mnogi mufessiri to shvataju kao zadržanu tugu, poput zadržanog daha.
explanation.en: On the Day of the approaching (doom), “when the hearts will be choking the throats” — many mufassirun understand it as grief held in, like held breath.

quranTranslation.text: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers!

explanation.bs: „Da neka duša ne bi rekla: Jao meni (doslovno: o tugo moja) zbog onoga što sam prema Allahu zanemarila!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: anguish, sorrow over what is lost

quranTranslation.text: And those who were but followers will say: If a return were possible for us, we would disown them even as they have disowned us. Thus will Allah show them their own deeds as anguish for them, and they will not emerge from the Fire.

explanation.bs: „Tako će im Allah pokazati njihova djela kao jad za njih“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Thus will Allah show them their own deeds as anguish for them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: anguish, sorrow over what is lost

quranTranslation.text: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.

explanation.bs: „I opomeni ih na Dan jada, kada se o stvari presudi“ – Dan kad se stvar odluči.
explanation.en: “And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided” — the Day on which the matter is settled.

gloss.en: anguish, sorrow over what is lost

quranTranslation.text: Then Allah sent a raven scratching up the ground, to show him how to hide his brother's naked corpse. He said: Woe unto me! Am I not able to be as this raven and so hide my brother's naked corpse? And he became repentant.

explanation.bs: Ademov sin, kad je vidio gavrana: „…i postade od onih koji se kaju“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Adam's son, on seeing the raven: “And he became repentant” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

explanation.bs: „Ako vam fasik dođe s nekom viješću, dobro je ispitajte, da ne biste iz neznanja nekim ljudima naudili, pa da se zbog učinjenog kajete“ – kajanje zbog prenagljene odluke.
explanation.en: “If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did” — regret for a hasty decision.

quranTranslation.text: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.

explanation.bs: Semud: „Pa su joj presjekli tetive, i ujutro su se kajali (doslovno: osvanuli su kao pokajnici)“ – kajanje koje dođe nakon djela.
explanation.en: Thamūd: “But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent” — regret that came after the deed.

quranTranslation.text: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.

explanation.bs: „I povjerovali su, pa smo im dali da uživaju do nekog vremena.“ – ḥīn kao rok; ar-Rāġib navodi iste riječi iz 10:98.
explanation.en: “And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.” — ḥīn as a term; ar-Rāġib cites the same words from 10:98.

quranTranslation.text: So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning -

explanation.bs: „Pa slavljen neka je Allah kad zanoćite i kad osvanete“ – ḥīn kao doba dana; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning” — ḥīn as an hour of the day; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?

explanation.bs: „Zar nije nad čovjekom prošlo neko vrijeme od vijeka kad nije bio ništa spomena vrijedno?“ – ḥīn iz dahra: neko vrijeme iz dugog vijeka; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za obje riječi.
explanation.en: “Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?” — a ḥīn out of the dahr: a while out of the long age; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for both words.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.

explanation.bs: „… i ništa nas ne uništava osim vijeka …“ – riječi poricatelja; ar-Rāġib: rečeno je da se misli na vrijeme.
explanation.en: “naught destroyeth us save time [ad-dahr]” — the deniers' words; ar-Rāġib: it was said that time is meant.

quranTranslation.text: On the Day when every soul will find itself confronted with all that it hath done of good and all that it hath done of evil (every soul) will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil). Allah biddeth you beware of Him. And Allah is Full of Pity for (His) bondmen.

explanation.bs: „… poželjet će da između nje i toga bude dugo razdoblje …“ – razdoblje mjereno do kraja; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil)” — a span measured to its end; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.

explanation.bs: „… pa im je razdoblje dugo potrajalo i srca su im okorjela …“ – dugo razdoblje do kraja koji im nije bio poznat.
explanation.en: “but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened” — a long span to an end they did not know.

quranTranslation.text: And covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others. Unto men a fortune from that which they have earned, and unto women a fortune from that which they have earned. (Envy not one another) but ask Allah of His bounty. Lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „Ne priželjkujte ono po čemu je Allah jedne od vas izdigao iznad drugih … već od Allaha molite iz Njegove dobrote“ – želja usmjerena na tuđe, a pravac je molba Allahu.
explanation.en: “And covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others … but ask Allah of His bounty” — a wish aimed at what others have, turned instead into asking Allah.

gloss.en: to wish for, to long for

quranTranslation.text: But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers.

explanation.bs: „A oni je nikada neće poželjeti, zbog onoga što su njihove ruke prije poslale …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to wish for, to long for

quranTranslation.text: And they say: None entereth paradise unless he be a Jew or a Christian. These are their own desires. Say: Bring your proof (of what ye state) if ye are truthful.

explanation.bs: „Rekoše: ‚U Džennet će ući samo onaj ko je jevrej ili kršćanin.‘ To im je pusta želja. Reci: ‚Donesite dokaz …‘“ – želja nasuprot dokazu.
explanation.en: “None entereth paradise unless he be a Jew or a Christian. These are their own desires. Say: Bring your proof” — wish set against proof.

quranTranslation.text: It will not be in accordance with your desires, nor the desires of the People of the Scripture. He who doeth wrong will have the recompense thereof, and will not find against Allah any protecting friend or helper.

explanation.bs: „Nije stvar u vašim željama, ni u željama sljedbenika Knjige: ko učini zlo, bit će mu za to uzvraćeno …“ – mjerilo je djelo, a ne želja.
explanation.en: “It will not be in accordance with your desires, nor the desires of the People of the Scripture. He who doeth wrong will have the recompense thereof” — the measure is the deed, not the wish.

quranTranslation.text: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!

explanation.bs: „Pusti ih: neka se goste i naslađuju, i neka im nada odvlači pažnju – a poslije će znati!“ – nada koja odvlači od pripreme.
explanation.en: “Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!” — a hope that pulls away from preparing.

quranTranslation.text: Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.

explanation.bs: „… a ono što ostaje od dobrih djela – bolje je kao nagrada kod tvoga Gospodara i bolje kao nada“ – nada usmjerena na trajno.
explanation.en: “But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope” — hope set on what lasts.
